race.comment: MOON SWEEPER (1) was just under six weeks between runs when nailed late in the heavy (9) going to finish second to LEOVANNI over 1600m at this track. Looking for this trip and shapes as a leading contender with Nash Rawiller taking the reins. LEOVANNI (11) starting to hit her straps after winning her last two starts in good style. Stalked the speed and launched late to get the upper hand over 1600m at this track. Can get cover from the draw and no shock to see her salute again. MICHELANGELO (3) improving gelding kept fresh for this. Massive jump in grade with a sound seventh over 2400m in the G1 Queensland Derby at Eagle Farm on May 30. Kept ticking over with a subsequent trial win at Cowra. Top-three player with the 3kg claimer. HURRY MISS (10) solid run in Highway grade two-back, then up in class with a poor seventh over 1400m at this track in the heavy conditions. Ready for this trip. MAPLES (8) well-bred filly who deserves her chance in town after winning all three starts.
